REF-BM-21: only 'Select all shown' exists, which is capped to the current page (pageSize slice); there is no affordance to apply an action to the entire filtered collection across pages. REF-BM-23: notes use a contenteditable rich-text/HTML editor (execCommand bold/list) rendered as stored HTML, not markdown input/parsing. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive / Wayback snapshot integration anywhere in the code."
}
